dno_dashboard.subtitle: IEC single-DSO dominant (~80%) · IPP private ~20% (Dorad + OPC + Edeltech + Bazan) · 6 mehozot · ~80 sub-districts (nafot)
dno_dashboard.intro: Israel's distribution sector is dominated by Israel Electric Corporation (IEC, חברת החשמל לישראל), vertically integrated state-owned TSO + majority generator (~70% of generation) + majority DSO (~80% of distribution). IEC was founded in 1923 as the Palestine Electric Company under concession from the British Mandate, rebranded after independence in 1961. The 2021 electricity-sector reform carved out Noga ILITO as the independent system operator (market dispatch + transmission planning), but IEC retains physical-grid ownership + most generation. Private IPPs supply the remaining ~20%: Dorad Energy (Ashkelon, 840 MW CCGT, largest private), OPC Energy (multiple sites), Edeltech (multiple sites), and Bazan (Haifa, refinery-coupled). PUA (Public Utilities Authority — Electricity) regulates tariffs + service quality. Israel operates an effectively insular grid with no synchronous cross-border interconnect; the EuroAsia Interconnector (HVDC 2,000 MW IL ↔ Cyprus ↔ Greece) is planned for operational entry 2027-2028 and will end insularity mid-cohort-lifecycle.
